biological.citation: N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea-Induced Adaptor Protein 2 Sigma Subunit 1 (Ap2s1) Mutations Establish Ap2s1 Loss-of-Function Mice. (PMID: 29479578)
biological.summary: AP2S1 encodes the AP2σ subunit of the heterotetrameric AP-2 complex (with AP2α, AP2β, AP2μ) that is pivotal for clathrin-mediated endocytosis. Loss-of-function mutations impair internalization of the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) and cause familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia type-3 (FHH3). Homozygous Ap2s1del17/del17 mice were non-viable, dying between E3.5 and E9.5, indicating essential roles during embryonic patterning and organogenesis.

biological.citation: The HAVCR1-centric host factor network drives Zika virus vertical transmission. (PMID: 40156834)
biological.summary: A genome-wide CRISPR screen in placental trophoblasts identified AP2S1 as a host factor cooperating with HAVCR1 for Zika virus internalization through clathrin-mediated endocytosis. Proteomic profiling and functional analyses confirmed that AP2S1 facilitates ZIKV entry in placental cells.

biological.citation: High-Confidence Interactome for RNF41 Built on Multiple Orthogonal Assays. (PMID: 29560723)
biological.summary: AP2S1 was identified as a novel RNF41 interaction partner in a high-confidence interactome built from affinity purification-mass spectrometry, BioID, Virotrap, MAPPIT, and Y2H screens. Functional validation revealed a role for AP2S1 in leptin and LIF receptor signaling, and RNF41 was shown to stabilize and relocate AP2S1.

biological.citation: GTPase GPN3 facilitates cell proliferation and migration in non-small cell lung cancer by impeding clathrin-mediated endocytosis of EGFR. (PMID: 39893205)
biological.summary: AP2S1 was identified as a binding partner of GPN3 along with clathrin light chain A (CLTA) and AP2B1, placing AP2S1 within the clathrin-mediated endocytosis machinery regulating EGFR internalization. GPN3 interaction with AP2S1 and other AP-2 complex modulators inhibits clathrin-coated pit invagination and reduces EGFR endocytosis.

biological.citation: Proteomics Reveals AP-2 Complex Depletion Suppressing Listeria monocytogenes Intracellular Replication. (PMID: 40847839)
biological.summary: L. monocytogenes infection significantly upregulates Ap2s1 expression in Raw264.7 macrophages, DC2.4 dendritic cells, HeLa, and Caco-2 epithelial cells. CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knockout of Ap2s1 (along with Ap2m1 and Ap2a2) markedly inhibited intracellular bacterial proliferation, demonstrating that the AP-2 complex, including AP2S1, is exploited by the pathogen to facilitate post-phagosomal cytosolic replication.

biological.citation: Codon Arg15 mutations of the AP2S1 gene: common occurrence in familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia cases negative for calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) mutations. (PMID: 24731014)
biological.summary: Loss-of-function mutations at codon Arg15 of AP2S1 (p.R15C, p.R15L, p.R15H) were identified in 5 of 39 (13%) CASR-mutation-negative FHH patients, confirming AP2S1's role as a regulator of CaSR internalization via clathrin-mediated endocytosis. These mutations cause FHH type 3 by impairing AP2σ interaction with CaSR, leading to hypercalcemia and hypocalciuria.

biological.citation: Familial Hypocalciuric Hypercalcemia Types 1 and 3 and Primary Hyperparathyroidism: Similarities and Differences. (PMID: 26963950)
biological.summary: Three recurrent AP2S1 loss-of-function mutations were identified in 19 of 133 families with FHH, establishing AP2S1 as the causative gene for FHH type 3. Patients with FHH type 3 (AP2S1 mutations) had higher plasma calcium concentrations and higher renal tubular calcium reabsorption than FHH type 1 (CASR mutations), indicating that AP2S1 mutations affect calcium homeostasis more severely.

biological.citation: In Vitro Control of Genes Critical for Parathyroid Embryogenesis by Extracellular Calcium. (PMID: 32666007)
biological.summary: AP2S1 mRNA expression was assessed in primary cultures of adult parathyroid adenoma tissue across a range of extracellular calcium concentrations (0.1–3.0 mM). Unlike CaSR and GNA11, which showed sensitivity to low calcium, AP2S1 exhibited a variable and less pronounced response to extracellular calcium, indicating differential transcriptional regulation within the calcium signaling pathway in parathyroid cells.

biological.citation: Mutational analysis of the adaptor protein 2 sigma subunit (AP2S1) gene: search for autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 3 (ADH3). (PMID: 24708097)
biological.summary: Sequencing of AP2S1 in 19 hypocalcemic patients without CASR or GNA11 mutations found no AP2S1 mutations or copy number variations, suggesting that gain-of-function AP2S1 mutations causing autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 3 (ADH3) either do not occur or are extremely rare. This contrasts with the established role of AP2S1 loss-of-function mutations in FHH3.
biological.significance: Binomial probability >95% power to detect mutation if prevalence ≥20%

biological.citation: Proteomic analysis of boar sperm with differential ability of liquid preservation at 17 °C. (PMID: 38029685)
biological.summary: Quantitative proteomics (TMT labeling) of boar sperm identified AP2S1 as one of 8 candidate biomarker proteins differentially expressed between sperm with good versus poor liquid preservation ability. AP2S1 was identified through protein-protein interaction network analysis as a potentially key protein related to sperm preservation quality.
